verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation's own product page states that users can turn off notifications with Do Not Disturb, which is exactly the story's capability. The support is a single first-party marketing line with no deeper documentation or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how Do Not Disturb works (toggle location, scope, scheduling or exceptions), independent or community confirmation.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can silence notifications using a Do Not Disturb mode
